Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.

225-1479-5700-5701-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4476-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

465-670-1619-6145.description:

When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Passageway Seer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Passageway Seer from exile to the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Passageway Seer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
